name: Wait In Line For Lebron
desc:
THE KING IS IN PHILLY!

👥 Massive Multiplayer Line Simulator

Join a line of players, all waiting for their chance to see the GOAT!
Feel Free to impede your friends abilities to meet the king.

🎮 Gameplay Features:
✔️ Realistic waiting mechanics – patience is key!
✔️ Dynamic crowd reactions – experience the excitement of those ahead of you!
✔️ Sabotage mechanics – Don't make enemies!

👍+ Join the group for 10m cash!
